requirement.description: The validate_tags function in batch.py incorrectly rejects Tags instances. The function checks if the value is a dict and not a Tags instance, but fails to properly handle the case where a Tags instance is passed as the value. This causes a TypeError when trying to use Tags objects with JobDefinition resources.
requirement.contract: The validate_tags function should accept Tags instances and AWSHelperFn objects, while still rejecting plain dicts. When a Tags instance is passed, it should be accepted without raising an error.

requirement.description: The DynamoDB Table resource expects Tags to be validated using the Tags class directly, but the test is passing a plain dict instead of a Tags instance. This causes a TypeError because the validation doesn't allow plain dicts for Tags fields in DynamoDB.
requirement.contract: The DynamoDB Table resource should accept Tags instances for the Tags property, similar to how other resources work. The validation should allow Tags instances to be passed as values for the Tags property.
